name: Abdiel
overview: Abdiel is a male member of the tribe of Gad, identified specifically as the son of Guni. His tribal affiliation as a Gadite situates him within one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and his lineage is noted in 1 Chronicles 5:15. There are no additional notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Abdiel means 'servant of God [El],' reflecting a Hebrew theophoric name that acknowledges service and devotion to God. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 5:15 and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Abdiel is the son of Guni, as stated in 1 Chronicles 5:15. It is also inferred that Ahi is his father, establishing a generational link within his family line. No further family relationships are documented beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Abdiel's significance in the biblical narrative lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Gad. As a Gadite and descendant of Guni, he contributes to the historical record of Israel's tribal families, which is important for understanding the continuity and identity of God's people. His mention in 1 Chronicles 5:15 preserves the heritage of the tribe during the chronicling of Israel's history.
